title: SpaceBuildSpace
description: space.build-space@1: one of a person's own spaces, as their agent sees it while it builds (OpenVibe.Space's builder API; plan 2026-10-22 §Z stage Z1). The id, the slug it publishes under, its name and description, whether it is published and where, and when it last changed. Nothing about anyone else's space is ever in this shape.
